seo.title: Stone Town Heritage Hotel | Zanzibar Heavenly
seo.description: Stay in a restored 19th-century merchant’s house in the heart of Stone Town. Rooftop restaurant, plunge pool, and complimentary breakfast from $95/night.

content:
The Stone Town Heritage Hotel occupies a beautifully restored 19th-century merchant’s house on one of the old quarter’s most atmospheric streets. Original carved Zanzibari doors open into a cool, tiled courtyard where a fountain trickles beneath a canopy of bougainvillea—a world away from the lively alleyways just outside.

Each room has been individually designed to honour the building’s history while providing modern comfort. Expect four-poster beds draped in white muslin, hand-plastered lime walls, brass fixtures, and antique Swahili furniture alongside reliable air conditioning and fast Wi-Fi. The rooftop is the hotel’s crowning feature: a terrace restaurant serving Zanzibari and international cuisine with uninterrupted views over the Stone Town skyline, its minarets and church spires silhouetted against spectacular Indian Ocean sunsets. A small plunge pool offers a refreshing dip after a day of exploring. The location could not be better—Forodhani Gardens, the Old Fort, and the waterfront are all within a five-minute walk.
